title.zh: 缓存一致性问题：两份缓存，一份旧了
title.en: The coherence problem: two caches, one stale copy

description.zh: 每个核心有自己的写回缓存，同一个数会同时有几份；一个核心改了自己那份，别人不知道就一直读旧值。四步操作，在没有协议和 MESI 下各走一遍。
description.en: Each core has its own write-back cache, so one value can have several copies; if one core changes its copy and nobody hears, the others keep reading the old value. Four steps, run with no protocol and with MESI.

zh: 多核缓存为什么会不一致

title.zh: 一致性的两条规矩：单写多读与数据值
title.en: Two invariants: single writer, multiple readers, and data value

description.zh: 缓存一致性只要求两件事：同一时刻一个地址要么一个核心能写、要么多个核心只能读；每一段开头读到的值等于上一段写完的值。按缓存行执行，不按变量。
description.en: Coherence asks for two things: at any time a location has either one writer or several readers; the value at the start of each epoch equals the value at the end of the last read-write epoch. Enforced per cache line, not per variable.

description.zh: 每个缓存在共享总线上偷听别人的请求，按状态表改自己那一行。四核四行的模拟器，把同一串读写交给三种协议各跑一遍，比总线请求和写回次数。
description.en: Every cache listens to the others' requests on a shared bus and changes its copy by a state table. A four-core, four-line simulator runs one access sequence under three protocols and counts bus requests and writebacks.

title.zh: 目录协议：核心多了怎么办

description.zh: 给每一行指定一个家，记下谁手里有它，请求只发给名单上的人；代价是多一跳和存名单的位。目录占多少存储、窥探与目录各要多少条消息，随核心数变化。
description.en: Each line gets a home that records who holds it, and requests go only to those cores; the price is an extra hop and the bits for the list. Directory storage and messages per miss, snooping versus directory, as cores grow.

zh: 基于目录的缓存一致性
总线窥探和目录协议的区别

title.zh: 丢失的更新：两个线程各加一百万次
title.en: The lost update: two threads each add a million

description.zh: 读、加一、写回三步会被别人插进来。把两个线程所有可能的先后顺序都数出来，看结果的分布和最小可能的值；再用随机调度跑一百万次。
description.en: Read, add one, write back: another thread can slip in between. Every interleaving of two threads counted exactly, with the distribution of results and the smallest possible one; then a random scheduler runs a million each.

zh: 两个线程加一百万次结果不对
为什么多线程加法结果不对
en: why multithreaded counter gives wrong result

title.en: Atomic instructions: LOCK, CAS, LL/SC and LSE

description.zh: 原子指令把读改写做成不能被插队的整体，缓存的做法是把这一行要成 M、做完之前不交出去。CAS 循环与原子加法在多线程下各要多少步。
description.en: An atomic instruction makes read-modify-write one indivisible step; the cache does it by taking the line in M and not giving it up until done. Steps per increment for a CAS loop and for fetch-and-add as threads grow.

title.zh: 核心之间搬一行要多久
title.en: How long a line takes to move between cores

description.zh: 几个核心轮流改同一行，这一行每次都要从一个缓存搬到另一个。用实测的核间延迟算共用一个计数器每秒能加多少次，和每人一个计数器比。
description.en: When cores take turns writing one line, it moves from cache to cache every time. Measured core-to-core latencies give how many increments per second a shared counter can do, against one counter per thread.

zh: 多线程共用计数器为什么慢
en: why a shared counter is slow

title.zh: 顺序一致性与存储缓冲
title.en: Sequential consistency and the store buffer

description.zh: 顺序一致性要求所有线程的操作排成一条队。存储缓冲让写晚一点生效，于是两个线程都读到 0。石蕊测试模型在 SC、x86-TSO 和弱模型下穷举所有执行。
description.en: Sequential consistency says all threads' operations form one order. A store buffer lets a write take effect late, so both threads can read 0. A litmus-test model enumerates every execution under SC, x86-TSO and a weak model.

title.zh: x86-TSO 与 Arm、RISC-V 的弱模型：栅栏、获取与释放
title.en: x86-TSO versus Arm and RISC-V weak ordering: fences, acquire and release

description.zh: x86 只让后面的读跑到前面的写之前；Arm 与 RISC-V 几乎都允许，要顺序得用栅栏或获取、释放。传消息测试在两类机器上的差别，以及 C++ 与 Java 内存模型的约定。
description.en: x86 lets only a later load pass an earlier store; Arm and RISC-V allow almost any reordering, and order must be asked for with fences or acquire and release. The message-passing test on both, and the rule behind the C++ and Java memory models.

zh: x86 和 ARM 内存序

title.zh: 锁的扩展性：TAS、TTAS、排号锁与 MCS
title.en: Lock scaling: TAS, TTAS, ticket and MCS

description.zh: 一把锁每换一次主人，等锁的核心怎么等决定了引起多少次总线请求。四种自旋锁在 MESI 模拟器上跑，每次交接的总线请求随核心数怎么涨。
description.en: How waiting cores wait decides how many bus requests each lock handoff costs. Four spinlocks run on the MESI simulator: bus requests per handoff as the number of cores grows.

title.zh: 前沿（2026 年 11 月）：几百个核心的一致性域
title.en: Frontier (November 2026): coherence domains of hundreds of cores

description.zh: 服务器 CPU 一颗两三百个核心、两路五六百个共享一份一致的内存；实测的核间延迟、苹果芯片的 TSO 模式，以及用时间戳代替名单的研究。分清已确立、已演示和厂商声称。
description.en: Server CPUs now put two to three hundred cores in one coherent memory, five to six hundred across two sockets; measured core-to-core latency, Apple's TSO mode, and research that replaces sharer lists with timestamps. Established, demonstrated and claimed kept apart.

zh: 服务器 CPU 最多多少核
en: how many cores share coherent memory

title.zh: 写共享数据前问三件事
title.en: Three questions before writing shared data

description.zh: 会被几个线程写？在弱内存模型的机器上测过吗？等锁的人多吗？一致性是硬件给的，正确性和速度要自己挣。
description.en: How many threads write it? Has it run on a weakly ordered machine? How many wait for the lock? Coherence comes from the hardware; correctness and speed are up to you.

zh: 多线程共享变量怎么写
多线程程序怎么写才快
en: how to write shared data in multithreaded code
